use default

erdos_nicolas(limit: int) -> Pipe[(value: int, k: int)] is
    let running_sum = LIST(limit + 1)
    let divisors_used = LIST(limit + 1)
    let divisors_at_hit = LIST(limit + 1)
    let has_later_divisor = LIST(limit + 1)

    for _ in 0::limit do
        running_sum.add(0)
        divisors_used.add(0)
        divisors_at_hit.add(0)
        has_later_divisor.add(false)
    od

    for divisor in 1::limit / 2 do
        let multiple mut = divisor * 2

        while multiple <= limit do
            if divisors_at_hit[multiple] > 0 then
                has_later_divisor[multiple] = true
            elif running_sum[multiple] < multiple then
                running_sum[multiple] = running_sum[multiple] + divisor
                divisors_used[multiple] = divisors_used[multiple] + 1

                if running_sum[multiple] == multiple then
                    divisors_at_hit[multiple] = divisors_used[multiple]
                fi
            fi
            multiple = multiple + divisor
        od
    od

    for value in 2::limit do
        if divisors_at_hit[value] > 1 /\ has_later_divisor[value] then
            yield (value, divisors_at_hit[value])
        fi
    od
si

for (value, k) in erdos_nicolas(1_600_000) do
    write_line("{value,8} equals the sum of its first {k,2} divisors")
